mapper.sql: id,media_type AS mediaType,usage_type AS usageType, storage_provider AS storageProvider,bucket_name AS bucketName, object_key AS objectKey,url,original_name AS originalName, content_type AS contentType,size_bytes AS sizeBytes,width,height, duration_seconds AS durationSeconds,status,retry_count AS retryCount, last_error AS lastError,next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, created_by AS createdBy,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt, deleted,deleted_at AS deletedAt,deleted_by AS deletedBy
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_asset WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM media_asset WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE media_asset SET status='ACTIVE',url=#{url},last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND deleted=0

UPDATE media_asset SET status='UPLOAD_FAILED',last_error=#{error},retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOADING' AND deleted=0
UPDATE media_asset SET status='DELETING',deleted_by=#{ownerId},last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','DELETE_FAILED') AND deleted=0
UPDATE media_asset SET status='DELETED',deleted=1,deleted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),deleted_by=#{ownerId}, last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DELETING' AND deleted=0

UPDATE media_asset SET status='DELETE_FAILED',last_error=#{error},retry_count=retry_count+1, next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DELETING' AND deleted=0
UPDATE media_asset SET status='DELETING',deleted_by=#{ownerId},last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='UPLOAD_FAILED' AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media_asset WHERE deleted=0 AND status IN ('UPLOAD_FAILED','DELETE_FAILED') AND retry_count < 5 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at,created_at),id LIMIT #{limit}
